faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Questions about our custom tour process? Find answers to common queries below.
faq.question1: How quickly will I receive my personalized tour offer?
faq.answer1: We typically respond within 24-48 hours with an initial proposal. For more complex multi-country tours, it may take up to 72 hours to create a detailed itinerary.
faq.question2: Can I modify the tour offer after receiving it?
faq.answer2: Absolutely! We see the initial proposal as a starting point for discussion. Our team will work with you to refine the itinerary until it perfectly matches your preferences.
faq.question3: Is a deposit required when requesting a tour offer?
faq.answer3: No, requesting a personalized tour offer is completely free and without obligation. A deposit is only required after you have approved the final itinerary and are ready to book.
faq.question4: How far in advance should I request a tour?
faq.answer4: For the best availability, especially during peak season (May-September), we recommend requesting your tour at least 2-3 months in advance. Last-minute requests are possible but may have limited options.
faq.answer5: Our cancellation policy varies depending on the tour and services booked. Please ask your travel consultant for specific details.
faq.question6: Can I book a tour for a large group?
faq.answer6: Yes, we can accommodate large groups. Please contact us for a custom quote and to discuss the details of your group's needs.
